findings: Pinned source supports git archive revision input, SHA256-addressed retained archive, from_run digest check, exact shell template and current-machine environment boundary.

Independent primitive reproduction succeeds with committed 2+3 despite dirty worktree and fails after local export-ignore removes data.txt from archive of same commit. This supports archive-identity limit, not a product defect claim.

Paper source confirms overview by default, abs for full, fallback on 404 only, and non-success propagation. Recorded 403 results support zero accepted acquisitions in that screen, not global endpoint quality or invalid-ID behavior.

Existing agent harness and local-model documentation support treating this as agent/workspace/compute tooling; absence of demonstrated recurring accepted FR outcomes is correctly phrased as not established.

README explicitly separates accepted outcomes per total human hour from machine execution, excludes missing baseline and reuse benefit, and invents no measured multiplier. Its 0.1 percent cap is an idealized fixed-output residual-work bound, not an observation.
Defer installation is a reasonable bounded operational decision. It does not demonstrate comparative research quality or that OpenResearch cannot be useful for multi-branch experiments.
